system.description:
Mark 2 Stress to make an Interface
Roll, unleashing a self-replicating
attack on all targets within Close range.
Targets you succeed against must
make a Reaction Roll with a Difficulty
equal to the result of your Interface
Roll. Targets who fail take 2d8+4
techno damage.
Additional adversaries not already
targeted by Viral Cascade and within
Close range of previous targets who
took damage must also make the
Reaction Roll. Targets who fail take
2d8+4 techno damage. This chain
continues until there are no more
adversaries within range.
